actual_complete_collector_template:
<xsl:template name="column-marks-preamble">
        <xsl:param name="parallel" as="xs:boolean" select="true()"/>
        <xsl:text>\directlua{
OScolumnmarks = { S = {}, L = {}, R = {} }
function OScolumnmarks.collect(side, boxnum)
 local box = tex.box[boxnum]
 if not box then return end
 local head = box.head
 local n = head
 while n do
  local nextnode = n.next
  if n.id == node.id("mark") then
   head = node.remove(head, n)
   n.next = nil
   n.prev = nil
   table.insert(OScolumnmarks[side], n)
  end
  n = nextnode
 end
 box.head = head
end
function OScolumnmarks.flush(side)
 for _, n in ipairs(OScolumnmarks[side]) do node.write(n) end
 OScolumnmarks[side] = {}
end
}
\makeatletter
\patchcmd{\do@line}{\unvbox\one@line}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.collect("S", \number\one@line)}\unvbox\one@line}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not collect single-stream marks}{}}
\pretocmd{\add@penalties}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.flush("S")}}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not flush single-stream marks}{}}
\apptocmd{\print@eledsection}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.flush("S")}}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not flush single-stream heading marks}{}}
</xsl:text>
        <xsl:if test="$parallel">
        <xsl:text>\patchcmd{\do@lineL}{\unvbox\one@line}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.collect("L", \number\one@line)}\unvbox\one@line}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not collect L marks}{}}
\patchcmd{\do@lineR}{\unvbox\one@lineR}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.collect("R", \number\one@lineR)}\unvbox\one@lineR}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not collect R marks}{}}
\pretocmd{\checkpb@columns}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.flush("L");OScolumnmarks.flush("R")}}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not flush column marks}{}}
\pretocmd{\checkpageL}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.flush("L")}}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not flush L marks}{}}
\pretocmd{\checkpageR}{\directlua{OScolumnmarks.flush("R")}}{}{\PackageError{opensiddur}{could not flush R marks}{}}

new_regression_test:
r"""Running-head marks must not disturb reledmac's extraction of single lines.

Compare actual PDF word coordinates with and without chapter milestones. The
same paragraph contains marks at its start, middle and end; a following
paragraph catches a mark queue escaping into the next one. The marks must also
reach the running head, rather than being discarded to repair the geometry.
"""
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from opensiddur.tests.exporter.stylesheet_helpers import transform

_WORD = re.compile(r'<word xMin="([\d.]+)" yMin="([\d.]+)" '
                   r'xMax="([\d.]+)" yMax="([\d.]+)">([^<]*)</word>')


def _document(marked):
    words = []
    for n in range(150):
        if marked and n in (0, 27, 89):
            words.append(f'<tei:milestone unit="chapter" n="{17 + n}"/>')
        words.append(f'word{n}')
    if marked:
        words.append('<tei:milestone unit="chapter"/>')
    tail = ' '.join(f'next{n}' for n in range(50))
    return ('<tei:TEI xmlns:tei="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:lang="en">'
            '<tei:text><tei:body><tei:p>' + ' '.join(words) + '</tei:p>'
            '<tei:p>' + tail + '</tei:p></tei:body></tei:text></tei:TEI>')


@unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('lualatex') and shutil.which('pdftotext'),
                     'requires lualatex and pdftotext')
class TestSingleStreamMarkGeometry(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.rendered = {}
        for marked in (False, True):
            tex = transform(_document(marked),
                            typography={'line_numbers': {'enabled': False}},
                            **{"distribution-notice": "", "back-notice": ""})
            # Read the first actual chapter mark from the PDF's running head.
            tex = tex.replace(r'\begin{document}',
                              r'\begin{document}\pagestyle{fancy}\fancyhf{}'
                              r'\fancyhead[R]{Chapter \FirstMark{OSchapter}}', 1)
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                work = Path(tmp)
                (work / 't.tex').write_text(tex)
                for _ in range(3):
                    done = subprocess.run(
                        ['lualatex', '-interaction=nonstopmode', '-halt-on-error', 't.tex'],
                        cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True)
                    if done.returncode:
                        raise AssertionError(done.stdout[-4000:])
                bbox = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-bbox', 't.pdf', '-'],
                                      cwd=work, check=True, capture_output=True,
                                      text=True).stdout
            all_words = list(_WORD.finditer(bbox))
            points = {m[5]: tuple(float(m[i]) for i in range(1, 5))
                      for m in all_words if re.fullmatch(r'(word|next)\d+', m[5])}
            cls.rendered[marked] = (points, [m[5] for m in all_words])

    def test_chapter_marks_preserve_every_word_and_its_line_geometry(self):
        plain, _ = self.rendered[False]
        marked, _ = self.rendered[True]
        self.assertEqual(200, len(plain))
        self.assertEqual(plain.keys(), marked.keys())
        for word in plain:
            for expected, actual in zip(plain[word][1::2], marked[word][1::2]):
                self.assertAlmostEqual(expected, actual, delta=0.05,
                                       msg=f'{word} moved after adding chapter marks')

    def test_collected_marks_still_reach_the_running_head(self):
        _, words = self.rendered[True]
        self.assertIn('Chapter', words)
        self.assertIn('17', words)
underlying_reledmac: do@line vsplits raw@text, unvboxes one@line, takes lastbox, then print@line outputs line hbox followed by add@penalties. print@eledsection handles section headings separately. A trailing mark blocks lastbox retrieval. Existing exporter already removes/reinserts mark nodes for parallel L/R, but omitted single streams.
reproducer: with-marks.pdf vs without-marks.pdf demonstrates only removing chapter marks restores geometry; single-collector.pdf preserves marks while restoring geometry. No source XML changed.
